meta_description: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 CDO Leg 3 review: September 20 at SM City CDO Uptown -- the Cagayan de Oro finale with the signature 32K distance.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at SM City CDO Uptown, this is the culminating third leg of the Cagayan de Oro series within Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia, featuring the signature 32K distance.
verdict: CDO Leg 3 closes out the Cagayan de Oro progression within the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia series, held at SM City CDO Uptown -- a modern mall development in a city that's demonstrated it can handle major regional race fields, having hosted the MILO Marathon's Mindanao-first National Finals in 2024. Distances run 5K/10K/21K up to the signature 32K, following the same progressive structure used across the series' Iloilo, Manila and Cebu legs. Registration status wasn't yet announced at the time of this research, consistent with several of the series' newer 2026 stops.

sections.heading: The CDO Finale of the Trilogy Series
paragraphs: CDO Leg 3 offers 5K, 10K, 21K and the signature 32K distance, held at SM City CDO Uptown in Cagayan de Oro. [1] Like the Iloilo, Manila and Cebu legs covered elsewhere in this research, the series builds progressively across the calendar year toward a National Finals qualification for finishers who complete the earlier legs' shorter distances.

sections.heading: A City With Proven Race Capacity
paragraphs: Cagayan de Oro has real recent credentials for hosting large-scale races -- in 2024, the city hosted the MILO Marathon's National Finals for the first time ever in Mindanao, drawing over 12,600 participants. [1] That track record for handling a major regional field is a meaningful point in favour of CDO Leg 3's own logistics, even though it's a different race series.

sections.heading: SM Uptown as a Modern Venue
paragraphs: SM City CDO Uptown is a newer, modern mall development in Cagayan de Oro, giving the race village built-in parking, shelter and amenities -- consistent with how other legs in this series use large SM-brand venues (SM Mall of Asia, SM Seaside) for their start/finish points. [2]

sections.heading: Registration Not Yet Announced
paragraphs: As of this writing, registration status for CDO Leg 3 has not been announced. [1] That's consistent with the pattern seen across several other newer legs in this 2026 series researched in this batch -- worth checking RunRio's official race calendar directly rather than assuming a similar timeline to the more established legs.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
